name: Biology graduate programs (PhD)
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application
publishedDeadlines.note: Published as stated; Fall 2027 applicability is not confirmed.

english.note: Official TOEFL scores required for international applicants whose native language is not English. No program minimum established.

applicationFee.note: Biology bulletin fee. Miller School waiver policy not transferred to Arts and Sciences.

documents: Statement of purpose identifying interests,projects,career goals and faculty sponsor
requirements.note: AppropriateBS may enterPhDdirectly; faculty sponsorship a condition of admission; sponsor becomes major advisor. At least one semester teaching required. GRE not established from accessible sources.

timeline.interviews: Limited candidates interviewed early January at departmental expense (undated).

funding.note: Department intends to support all doctoral students in good standing up to10semesters; beyond requiresGAACapproval. Annual progress updates required. No stipend amount or unconditional guarantee stated.
